Name: Knocket
Tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
Description: Makers need a way for visitors to reach them, and to reply without opening another dashboard. Paste one script tag and a chat bubble appears on any site, or publish a contact page for your bio. Visitors start typing with no account needed. Messages go to Telegram. Quote-reply and it appears on their screen, and the thread stays in your inbox. If you're away, they leave an email. An AI agent answers from your docs and hands off to you when it matters. Free, no credit card, live in minutes.

Name: ngram 2.0
Tagline: Create explainers, screencasts, and AI avatar videos
Description: Turn ideas, documents, and recordings into narrated videos. ngram analyzes uploaded videos and screen recordings to identify key moments and build clear product walkthroughs. Create animated explainers or add an AI avatar presenter, then refine your video in chat.

Name: Bearconnect 2.0
Tagline: AI-Powered LinkedIn Platform for Content and Outreach
Description: Bearconnect started as a LinkedIn outreach tool. With V2, it’s now a platform for both inbound and outbound on LinkedIn. Create and schedule content, find prospects from LinkedIn activity, and turn intent into conversations with AI-powered messaging. V2 also adds team workspaces, role-based access, Brand Voice, CRM integrations, and webhooks.

Name: Ancher 2.0
Tagline: Turn everything you read and save into work you can ship
Description: Ancher is an AI knowledge workspace that turns everything you read, watch, and save into work you can actually use. Capture articles, videos, PDFs, posts, and ideas without organizing folders. Ancher connects related knowledge, lets you search and ask questions across your sources, and helps turn what you've learned into research briefs, reports, presentations, and content in your own voice. Your saved knowledge becomes more useful every time you add to it.

Name: Base Code
Tagline: Let your whole team build on your product
Description: Base Code lets teams work directly on existing codebases from the browser. Connect GitHub, describe changes in plain language, preview them live, and send completed work through standard pull requests.

Name: Google EmbeddingGemma 2
Tagline: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
Description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.

Name: Manifold MCP
Tagline: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent
Description: Manifold gives your agent live data from every marketing channel, in one hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code. Find keywords one push from page one. See if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend you. Watch the TikToks winning your niche. Read your competitors’ live ads. Catch Reddit threads asking for what you make. Get verified emails for buyers looking right now. Ask in plain words and your agent does the work. No pile of tabs. Free to start.

Name: Hexis Cloud
Tagline: One company brain for all your AI agents
Topics: Productivity, Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that's important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it's context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!

Name: guilds.run
Tagline: The open-source Grok Bot alternative
Description: Open-source AI agent teams you can actually inspect. Debug every prompt, tool call, memory change, and agent interaction. Control permissions, edit context, and choose the model for each agent. Self-host for free. Stop guessing what your agents are doing.

Name: Strawberry
Tagline: The AI browser where teams and agents work together
Description: Think Claude or Codex, but built around the place where most work actually happens. Strawberry puts powerful AI agents inside the interface you know: a browser. Build companions that research prospects, source candidates, update CRMs and sheets, create reports, draft outreach, and run recurring workflows inside your logged-in apps. Once you've built a great companion, share it with across your team (sales, recruiting, operations and founders) so everyone can put the same workflow to work.

Name: Dropstone CLI
Tagline: The self-learning coding agent for your terminal
Description: Dropstone CLI is a coding agent that learns from you. It reads your repo, edits across files, runs commands and tests, and checks its work before it says it's done. Correct it once and it keeps the lesson across sessions. Pick Fast, Pro, or Heavy models, plan before it builds, and set which commands run, ask first, or are blocked. Add skills, custom agents, parallel subagents, and MCP tools. Comment on a GitHub issue and it opens a pull request. On every plan, including Free.

Name: Scrape Anything by Context.dev
Tagline: Turn any website into clean data with one API call.
Description: Scrape Anything by Context lets you pull clean, usable data from the web without building or maintaining scraping infrastructure. Give Context a URL and it handles rendering, blocks, proxies, retries, and extraction—returning Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured data through one API.

Name: Kudos 3.0
Tagline: The AI that finds money you're missing and gets it back
Topics: Android, Chrome Extensions, Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Personal Finance
Description: Most money apps show you charts. Kudos does the work. Your home shows Your wins, one number for everything Kudos has earned or saved you, and your next best money move. Most people don't know their cards come with personalized offers they have to turn on by hand. Kudos activates them for you: about $800/yr in offers in early testing. Our AI also calls providers to lower your bills ($216/yr per negotiation) and cancels subscriptions you forgot ($247/yr each). You keep 100% of the savings.

Name: ExcaliClaw
Tagline: Hand-drawn diagrams your AI agent can draw with you
Description: ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn diagrams. Organize them in collections, search instantly, share by link or by name, and draw together in real time. Its MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code create and edit diagrams for you. Generous free plan: 200 drawings and unlimited AI (MCP) use, no credit card. Paid plans from €9/month. Version history, trash and backup export included. English, Español, Français.

Name: SalesRep.com
Tagline: Your AI sales rep: live prices, quotes & follow-ups 24/7
Description: SalesRep is a virtual sales rep that sells for you 24/7. Pulls live prices & stock from Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Meta Catalog or your own database/API • Answers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email, SMS and more • Sends product cards and quotes on the fly, in any channel • Follows up until the deal closes, with human takeover anytime • 30+ languages, auto-detected Full-featured from $39/mo. 21-day free trial, no credit card required.

Name: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner
Tagline: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents
Description: Invited is an AI reminder scanner that turns bills, invitations, cheques, screenshots and PDFs into smart reminders. It extracts dates, times, places and amounts, supports 80+ languages and 9 calendars, and finds multiple reminders in one document.

Name: SquadRoom
Tagline: AI employees that work 24/7
Description: SquadRoom gives you a team of AI employees. A lead agent learns your company and plans the work. Specialists for research, writing, partnerships and operations do it. You drop a task on the board and walk away. When you come back, the work is finished and a report shows every step and every source. Agents only stop to ask you when a decision really needs you, and nothing goes out without your OK. Bring your own AI key. Try the live demo, no signup.

Name: Milepost
Tagline: An iOS driving journal for your car, with an MCP server
Description: Milepost is a driving journal for your car on iOS, with an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other compatible AI agents. Record routes, photos, notes, music, and moments in Roadbooks. Share with friends for reactions and comments, or send a public web link. Build your garage, collect city and state stamps in each car’s Stampbook, relive routes in 3D, and make animated shares and monthly recaps. Record for free; Pro unlocks older history, exports, and deeper insights.

Name: Codemind
Tagline: Delegate coding. Get back code that works.
Description: Your coding agent hands Codemind a task over MCP. It writes the code, tests it against your criteria and returns the files. $0.10 per verified build, failed builds free, free allowance to start.

Name: Understory Notes
Tagline: Notes that tell thet ale
Description: Understory is a Mac notes app for people who take notes in order to write something. Collect notes as you read, arrange them into an outline, and draft each section with your research beside it. Then publish as a PDF, Rich Text, Markdown or a website.
